products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and image editing application. The foundation describes its work as community-governed, with development and oversight carried out collectively rather than by a commercial entity. The software is made available under open-source terms with no cloud dependency required for core use.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what the site tracks as Krita AI, which incorporates local AI plugins into the Krita application. Because these plugins run locally, users are not reliant on external cloud services, which the foundation presents as a distinguishing characteristic of its approach to AI integration. The product sits within the image and graphic design category.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with the foundation in the held data.
